title: Jujutsu Kaisen
description: Wallpapers based on _Jujutsu Kaisen_, centered on its cursed energy and sorcery themes. The collection covers contemporary Japanese urban settings, shadowy supernatural environments, and the contrast the series draws between ordinary daily life and its darker, more violent side.
